parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix - for descending. Allowed: id, merged_shipment_number, status, created_at, shipped_at. Default: -id

parameters.name: filter[id]
parameters.description: Exact match on merge group ID

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Exact match on status. Allowed values: awaiting_pack, awaiting_label, awaiting_ship, shipped, cancelled, unmerged

parameters.name: filter[merged_shipment_number]
parameters.description: Partial (LIKE) match on the merged shipment number

parameters.name: filter[open_only]
parameters.description: If true (1, yes, true), restricts to open merge groups (status in awaiting_pack, awaiting_label, awaiting_ship). Cancelled and unmerged groups are excluded.
